concepts.def: Sharing the gospel by word and action
UK-wide Christian charity tackling global poverty
Movement toward unity between Christian churches

walkthroughs.body_html:
The Great Commission: 'Go and make disciples of all nations, baptising them in the name of the Father, Son and Holy Spirit' (Matthew 28:19).

Mission today happens through preaching, social action, education and example.

Christian Aid (founded 1945, originally to help refugees of WW2) works globally on poverty.

CAFOD (founded 1962) is the Catholic agency for overseas development.

Both work on long-term development as well as emergency aid — reflecting 'love your neighbour' (Mark 12:31) and the Sheep and Goats (Matthew 25:35-40).

Ecumenism seeks Christian unity. The World Council of Churches (founded 1948) and Churches Together in Britain and Ireland bring denominations together.

Around the world, Christians face persecution. Open Doors estimates over 360 million Christians face significant persecution today. Christians point to Jesus' words: 'Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness' (Matthew 5:10).
